author: Something Original
depicts: The overhanging rock ledge of McAfee Knob at right, above green rolling ridges and the Catawba Valley under a blue sky.
caption: McAfee Knob overlooking the Catawba Valley, Virginia
notes: Dual licensed CC BY-SA 3.0 or GFDL; using CC BY-SA 3.0. Stitched panorama, very wide (1280x408); may need cropping. No people.

author: Andrew Parlette from Elkridge, MD, US
depicts: A jumbled field of gray talus boulders on Blackrock Summit above autumn-colored forested ridges and the Shenandoah Valley under dramatic clouds.
caption: Blackrock Summit, Shenandoah National Park, Virginia
notes: From Flickr; Commons license review passed 2 August 2023 (FlickreviewR 2). Taken 23 October 2021. No people. Not the Blackrock viewpoint near Big Meadows (a different place).

author: Famartin
depicts: Open grassy highland meadow with shrubs and spruce trees rising to the rocky crest of Wilburn Ridge under a clear blue sky.
caption: Wilburn Ridge from the Appalachian Trail, Grayson Highlands State Park, Virginia
notes: Taken 16 May 2017 from the A.T. inside Grayson Highlands State Park; Wilburn Ridge is the ridge the A.T. follows toward Rhododendron Gap. Does not show the gap itself. No people.

author: Zeete
depicts: Jefferson Rock, a flat slab of shale propped on stone pillars, with the steeple of St. Peter's Church and the Shenandoah River below wooded hills.
caption: Jefferson Rock above Harpers Ferry, West Virginia
notes: Taken 2 September 2021, looking east. No people. NPGallery Jefferson Rock photos were public domain but carried no NPS photo credit, so not used.

author: Zeete
depicts: The round, tapered fieldstone Washington Monument tower on South Mountain, flanked by U.S. and Maryland flags under a clear blue sky.
caption: Washington Monument, Washington Monument State Park, Maryland
notes: Taken 2 September 2023. No people. Flags are small background elements.

author: Antony-22
depicts: The tall stone War Correspondents Memorial Arch with its castle-like turret and three upper arches, on a green lawn among spring trees.
caption: War Correspondents Memorial Arch, Gathland State Park, Maryland
notes: Taken 16 April 2016. The 1896 arch carries the inscription WAR CORRESPONDENTS as part of the structure; no people, no signs as main subject.

author: Ksk2875
depicts: Panoramic view southwest from Weverton Cliffs over the Potomac River winding between forested ridges, with a rail line and highway in the valley below.
caption: View from Weverton Cliffs over the Potomac River, Maryland
notes: Taken 30 July 2010. Very wide panorama (1280x281 at this size; original 4912x1080), hazy; will need cropping for a card. Only Commons candidate found. No people. Not used on the preview: 1280x281 hazy panorama too narrow for a destination photo.

author: Weston Brophy
depicts: View from the rocks of Bake Oven Knob over a wide autumn forest and patchwork farmland stretching to the horizon.
caption: View from Bake Oven Knob, Lehigh County, Pennsylvania
notes: From Flickr (Weston Brophy); Commons license review passed 28 February 2020. Taken 19 October 2013. A few tiny, unidentifiable hikers are visible far down in the trees. Bright, slightly washed-out sky. Bake_Oven_Knob_02 rejected (group of people as main subject); Bake_Oven_Knob_03 not viewed (rate limited).

author: Famartin
depicts: The tall stone obelisk of the High Point Monument atop a hill of autumn trees, seen across Lake Marcia with grassy shoreline in front.
caption: High Point Monument above Lake Marcia, High Point State Park, New Jersey
notes: Taken 18 October 2020. No people. Other monument photos in the category are portrait orientation.

author: Vanalii
depicts: Calm blue water of Sunfish Pond reflecting a leafless late-autumn forest, with rocks and bare shrubs on the near shore under a clear sky.
caption: Sunfish Pond from the Appalachian Trail, Worthington State Forest, New Jersey
notes: Taken 14 November 2020 from the southwest shore along the A.T. No people. Many Famartin 2014 alternatives exist (CC BY-SA 4.0) if a summer view is preferred.

No Commons category for Pochuck Creek or the boardwalk; Category:Appalachian_Trail_in_New_Jersey and Vernon Township categories hold no boardwalk photo. File:Flickr_-_Nicholas_T_-_Long_Walk.jpg (CC BY 2.0, Vernon Valley) was checked and rejected: it shows a dirt path through a grassy field with a power pylon, not the boardwalk.

author: Alexisrael
depicts: The stone Perkins Memorial Tower with its green roof on the rocky, grassy summit of Bear Mountain, with a rustic wooden bench on the bedrock in front.
caption: Perkins Memorial Tower on the summit of Bear Mountain, New York
notes: Taken 18 June 2012. No people. Overcast white sky. Alternative with a better sky but people at the edge: File:Perkins_Memorial_Tower_-_54493978052.jpg (Roadgeek Adam, CC BY-SA 2.0, Flickr review passed) was not used because three visitors appear at right.

author: Famartin
depicts: The tall granite Veterans War Memorial Tower, topped by a glass beacon, on the grassy summit of Mount Greylock with spruce trees under an overcast sky.
caption: Veterans War Memorial Tower on the summit of Mount Greylock, Massachusetts
notes: Taken 9 September 2018. A few small, distant, unidentifiable visitors near the tower base; not the subject. Gray overcast sky.

author: Dougtone
depicts: Thin streams of white water cascading down dark, steep ledges of Thundering Falls beside a moss-covered rock wall with ferns.
caption: Thundering Falls, Killington, Vermont
notes: From Flickr (Dougtone); Commons license review passed 1 November 2023. Taken 29 September 2013. PORTRAIT orientation (1280x1707); the series has about 20 more files of the same set, several landscape, if a landscape crop is needed. No people.

author: Jeff Pang
depicts: The rocky, frost-dusted Appalachian Trail running along the open crest of Franconia Ridge toward distant peaks, under dark clouds with sunbeams over the valleys.
caption: The Appalachian Trail on Franconia Ridge, New Hampshire
notes: From Flickr (Jeff Pang); Commons license review passed 30 January 2013. Taken 16 October 2011. Two small hikers seen from behind in the lower middle, faces not visible; the ridge is the subject.

author: Michael Sipos
depicts: Snow-capped Mount Katahdin rising above leafless woods and the dark blue West Branch of the Penobscot River under a clear sky.
caption: Katahdin from Abol Bridge, Maine
notes: Taken 8 April 2023 from Abol Bridge, where the A.T. crosses the river; shows the mountain, not the Hunt Trail itself. No people.

author: Drwilsonjjj
depicts: White water tumbling over pink granite ledges of Little Niagara Falls, framed by evergreens and early fall color, with a mountain in the distance.
caption: Little Niagara Falls, Baxter State Park, Maine
notes: Taken 26 September 2011. The file name says 'Canada' (uploader's error), but the description reads 'Little Niagra, Baxter, Maine, USA' and it is in Category:Baxter State Park; the scene matches Little Niagara on Nesowadnehunk Stream. Shows Little Niagara only, not Big Niagara. No people.

author: Brian Stansberry
depicts: A gravel Appalachian Trail path crossing the golden grass of Round Bald toward Jane Bald and the broad dome of Grassy Ridge Bald under a blue sky.
caption: The Appalachian Trail on Round Bald, looking toward Jane Bald, Roan Highlands
notes: Multi-licensed GFDL, CC BY-SA 3.0 and CC BY 2.5; CC BY 2.5 chosen (attribution only). Taken 19 November 2006. Original is 1198 px wide, so the 960 px thumbnail was saved. No people.

No Commons category for Long Creek Falls; Category:Waterfalls in Georgia (U.S. state) and Category:Appalachian Trail in Georgia hold only File:Long_Creek_Falls.png (224x296 px, no description, location not stated), which is far too small and not verifiable as the Fannin County falls.

No Lover's Leap photo in Category:Hot Springs, North Carolina (160 files) or Category:Appalachian Trail in North Carolina. The only river view there (File:View_of_French_Broad_River_and_Mountains_near_Hot_Springs,_NC.jpg) is 640x480 and shows the bridge, not Lover's Leap.

No Commons category or file for the Tennessee Laurel Fork Gorge or Falls near Hampton: checked Category:Hampton, Tennessee, Category:Carter County, Tennessee and its geography subcategory, and Category:Waterfalls in Tennessee (its Laurel files are Big Laurel Falls and Laurel Falls in the Smokies, different places).

No Commons category or file for Bear Den Mountain or Beagle Gap in Shenandoah National Park (checked Category:Shenandoah National Park, Mountains of Shenandoah National Park, Appalachian Trail in Shenandoah National Park). NPGallery keyword search for Bear Den Mountain returned nothing. Files named Bears den in Category:Appalachian Trail in Virginia are the Bluemont Bears Den, a different place.

No Commons category for Compton Peak; the only related file in Category:Appalachian Trail in Shenandoah National Park is a Compton Gap trailhead sign (sign as main subject, rejected). NPGallery keyword search returned no Compton Peak photos.

No Commons category or file for Thunder Ridge Overlook (checked Category:Scenic overlooks along the Blue Ridge Parkway in Virginia and Blue Ridge Parkway in Virginia). NPGallery has only 'Thunder Ridge Parking Area sign' (a sign as main subject, Public domain with Unknown granting rights), rejected.
